_about: Feat loop batch 5, lane b5-spells (2026-11-26): spell hooks, metamagic, and the situational
and plain modifiers left in the loop's list. Text from content/feats/feats.json (the OGL
sheet), checked against aonprd.com FeatDisplay pages 2026-11-26. The feats whose class,
race or system no player can reach are in docs/feats-waiting-on-classes.md, not here.

not_yet: negative levels and energy drain passing a death ward, and an undead's automatic save to shed them after 24 hours: the engine lays no negative levels (enervation and its kin are narrative, energy drain is reported, not applied)

modifiers.note: ARG: '+2 dodge bonus to Armor Class' in a terrain your Attuned to the Wild names; one bonus however many terrains match
ARG: '+4 bonus on Perception checks made to act in the surprise round' (rules/surprise.py rolls it as the ambush use)

Dragonslayer's Handbook: 'a bonus on Reflex saves against area of effect attacks equal to your shield's base bonus to armor class plus any bonuses granted by feats or class abilities' (Actor._shield_ac_for_feats); no enhancement; a spell's area and a class ability's shaped area both pass `area`

Blood of the Night: 'add your bravery bonus on Will saves against mind-affecting spells and effects from vampires. This does not stack with the normal bravery bonus on saves against fear effects': a vampire's fear effect is not vampire_mind (rules/spell_feats.py), so bravery alone answers it

F&P: 'For 1 round per character level after you perform combat meditation, whenever you attempt a concentration check to avoid losing a spell ... you gain a +4 bonus' (Combat Meditation lays meditation.combat for those rounds)
APG: '+2 bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks'; Craft is one skill on this sheet (tables.base_skill), so the term is Craft's

not_yet: poisons made a dose per point of Intelligence modifier at once: the alchemy bench makes no poisons

modifiers.note: Champions of Purity: 'When using good-aligned weapons, including those under the effects of a bless weapon spell, you gain a +1 sacred bonus on damage rolls' (a weapon that strikes as good: Actor._roll_context)

not_yet: bless weapon making a weapon good-aligned: the spell is narrative, so only a weapon that strikes as good by its own layer answers

modifiers.note: Faction Guide: '+5 bonus on Use Magic Device checks to use divine spell-trigger or spell completion items' (Engine._spell_item_gate passes the device's tradition)

not_yet: emulating a divine class feature: no Use Magic Device check emulates a class feature in the engine
the +4 on Bluff checks to pass secret messages: Bluff has no secret-message use (content/rules/skill-uses.json)

modifiers.note: APG: '+4 bonus on Perception checks to detect creatures with the shaken, frightened, or panicked conditions using scent' (awareness.check names the one looked for)

not_yet: using Perception in place of Sense Motive against a frightened subject or one covering up fear: a check is rolled with its own skill

modifiers.note: People of the North: '+2 bonus on initiative checks and a +1 bonus on attack rolls ... for 1 round after any round in which you take cold damage' (Actor.take_damage lays the round)

not_yet: the same bonuses in severe cold (below 0 F): the engine models one cold band (below 40 F, hazards.json cold), not severe cold
a torch as a simple weapon: an improvised blow does not tell the attack roll which object it is, so its -4 cannot be waived for a torch alone
the once-a-day reroll of a save against an effect that would put the light out: nothing in the engine puts out a carried light

modifiers.note: UC: '+2 bonus to AC against all flankers until the start of your next turn', while the swift action's one-round stance holds (content/class-abilities/feats-b5-spells.json)

not_yet: running itself, at five (or four) times speed while keeping the Dexterity bonus to AC: the engine has no run action, only moves and charges
